title: AMD action: getdatevisits
description: List office visits scheduled on one specific date for this practice. Returns date, count, by_provider, by_provider_id, by_profile, by_facility, by_facility_id, by_apptstatus, and a visits list. visits rows: visit_id, starttime, duration, apptstatus, provider_id, provider_name, facility_id, facility_name, profile, profile_id, reason, patient_id, patient_name, chart_number. Several text fields (reason, profile, starttime, patient_name, chart_number) may be blank on this office key; empties are real.
